## IPrecheckoutErrorBlock type

Pre-checkout error block for Telegram payments.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IPrecheckoutErrorBlock = {
    text: string;
};
```

## Remarks

Declared with `<g-precheckout-error>` blocks. `text` supports the same `{{var|filter}}` interpolation pipeline as poll questions and becomes the `error_message` shown when payment is declined (plain text without HTML per the Bot API `answerPreCheckoutQuery` limits).

## Example


```typescript
const declined: IPrecheckoutErrorBlock = {
  text: `Stok {{item}} habis`
}
```
